sources.role: config roots, input_configs layout, savedata, savestates, firmware install, CLI

paths.path: config.yml at the configuration root, default ~/.config/rpcs3/ (honors $XDG_CONFIG_HOME, falls back to $HOME/.config then ./config); an executable-adjacent portable/ directory takes precedence; input profiles live in input_configs/ with active_input_configurations.yml
paths.naming: input_configs/global/<profile>.yml (default profile "Default"); per-game overrides in input_configs/<TITLE_ID>/<profile>.yml; legacy builds instead wrote per-handler files such as input_configs/global/dinput/pad0.yml

paths.path: dev_hdd0/home/00000001/savedata/ under the configuration root (default ~/.config/rpcs3/dev_hdd0/; dev_hdd0 relocatable via the dev_hdd0 entry in vfs.yml, $(EmulatorDir) prefix)
paths.naming: one folder per game named by the game's savedata directory name (SAVEDATA_DIRECTORY in each PARAM.SFO; typically TITLE_ID-based, e.g. BLUS30463-...), containing PARAM.SFO, PARAM.PFD, ICON0.PNG plus per-game data files

paths.path: savestates/<TITLE_ID>/ under the configuration root (default ~/.config/rpcs3/savestates/), one subfolder per game keyed by TITLE_ID or the boot executable filename
paths.naming: <TITLE_ID>_<prefix>_<index>.SAVESTAT with .zst or .gz compressed variants preferred when present; index starts at 0 and the single-character prefix encodes the index digit length for name sorting

paths.path: no user BIOS file: PS3 firmware PS3UPDAT.PUP is chosen from any location and installed (GUI "Install firmware" dialog, or --installfw <path> on the command line) into dev_flash/ (plus dev_flash2/ and dev_flash3/) under the configuration root
paths.naming: installed firmware is the extracted dev_flash tree; RPCS3 prompts "Missing Firmware Detected!" with a Locate PS3UPDAT.PUP button when booting commercial games without it

linux.notes: Lunchbox's pinned contract (crates/lunchbox-app/src/controller_rpcs3.rs at 54014a7d) resolves the same portable/XDG/.config precedence, writes profiles into input_configs/global, and launches with --no-gui --input-config.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/net.rpcs3.RPCS3/config/rpcs3/config.yml with input profiles in ~/.var/app/net.rpcs3.RPCS3/config/rpcs3/input_configs/ (flatpak sandbox sets XDG_CONFIG_HOME to ~/.var/app/net.rpcs3.RPCS3/config; the manifest mounts home read-only, so all writes stay under ~/.var/app)
paths.naming: input_configs/global/<profile>.yml (default profile "Default"); per-game overrides in input_configs/<TITLE_ID>/<profile>.yml
one folder per game named by the game's savedata directory name (SAVEDATA_DIRECTORY in each PARAM.SFO; typically TITLE_ID-based), containing PARAM.SFO, PARAM.PFD, ICON0.PNG plus per-game data files
<TITLE_ID>_<prefix>_<index>.SAVESTAT with .zst or .gz compressed variants; index starts at 0 and the prefix encodes its digit length for name sorting

paths.path: no user BIOS file: PS3UPDAT.PUP from any location is installed via the GUI or --installfw into ~/.var/app/net.rpcs3.RPCS3/config/rpcs3/dev_flash/ (plus dev_flash2/, dev_flash3/)

linux-flatpak.notes: Community-maintained unofficial package; the correct id is net.rpcs3.RPCS3 (net.rpcs3.RPCSX3 does not exist: RPCSX is a different emulator project).

paths.path: config.yml under <root>\config\ next to rpcs3.exe by default; the root is the executable's own directory (portable-style), relocated by the RPCS3_CONFIG_DIR environment variable, or replaced wholesale by an executable-adjacent portable\ directory; a legacy config.yml directly in the root is auto-migrated into config\
paths.naming: input profiles at <root>\config\input_configs\global\<profile>.yml (default profile "Default") with active_input_configurations.yml alongside; per-game overrides in input_configs\<TITLE_ID>\<profile>.yml
evidence: source:Utilities/File.cpp fs::get_config_dir Windows branch, RPCS3_CONFIG_DIR, get_config_subdirectory appends config/ (pinned 54014a7d)

paths.path: <root>\dev_hdd0\home\00000001\savedata\ (dev_hdd0 sits directly under the root, not under config\; relocatable via vfs.yml)
paths.naming: one folder per game named by the game's savedata directory name (SAVEDATA_DIRECTORY in each PARAM.SFO; typically TITLE_ID-based), containing PARAM.SFO, PARAM.PFD, ICON0.PNG plus per-game data files

paths.path: <root>\savestates\<TITLE_ID>\ (savestates are built from fs::get_config_dir() without the config\ subfolder, so they sit directly under the root)
paths.naming: <TITLE_ID>_<prefix>_<index>.SAVESTAT with .zst or .gz compressed variants; index starts at 0 and the prefix encodes its digit length for name sorting

paths.path: no user BIOS file: PS3UPDAT.PUP from any location is installed via the GUI "Install firmware" dialog or --installfw <path> into <root>\dev_flash\ (plus dev_flash2\, dev_flash3\)

windows.notes: At the pinned commit Utilities/File.cpp no longer references %APPDATA%\RPCS3: the Windows default is the executable directory with RPCS3_CONFIG_DIR as the override and automatic migration of the deprecated root-level config.yml; older documentation still describing %APPDATA%\RPCS3 is outdated for this revision.

paths.path: ~/Library/Application Support/rpcs3/config.yml (from $HOME; get_config_dir's config/ subfolder is Windows-only, so config.yml sits directly in the root); an executable-adjacent portable/ directory takes precedence
paths.naming: input profiles in ~/Library/Application Support/rpcs3/input_configs/global/<profile>.yml (default profile "Default") with active_input_configurations.yml alongside; per-game overrides in input_configs/<TITLE_ID>/<profile>.yml
one folder per game named by the game's savedata directory name (SAVEDATA_DIRECTORY in each PARAM.SFO; typically TITLE_ID-based), containing PARAM.SFO, PARAM.PFD, ICON0.PNG plus per-game data files
<TITLE_ID>_<prefix>_<index>.SAVESTAT with .zst or .gz compressed variants; index starts at 0 and the prefix encodes its digit length for name sorting

paths.path: no user BIOS file: PS3UPDAT.PUP from any location is installed via the GUI "Install firmware" dialog or --installfw <path> into ~/Library/Application Support/rpcs3/dev_flash/ (plus dev_flash2/, dev_flash3/)

macos.notes: macOS builds resolve the root from $HOME per Utilities/File.cpp at the pinned commit; no first-party macOS binary is offered, but the path logic is platform source, not documentation.
